results.name: Sitting Bernie AR meme
results.description:
Lot of buzz today from a picture of Bernie Sanders (by Brendan Smialowski /AFP via Getty Images) sitting at the US Presidiential inauguration https://www.npr.org/sections/inauguration-day-live-updates/2021/01/20/958875766/bernie-sanders-wins-the-inauguration-day-meme-game

Bringing this into Sketchfab so anyone can drop it in AR anywhere :) Just hit the AR button at the bottom of the viewer.

Video demo: https://twitter.com/albn/status/1352066178580152320?s=21

I downloaded the png from [knowyourmeme.com](https://knowyourmeme.com/photos/1997104-bernie-sanders-in-parka-and-mittens-at-joe-bidens-inauguration)
